query:marked_cell_value.answer_instruction: the digit that must go in the marked empty cell
query:marked_cell_value.annotation_hint: Set annotation to an object with key "marked_cell" containing one image-pixel cell bounding box [x0,y0,x1,y1], and key "constraint_cells" containing image-pixel bounding boxes for the visible filled cells that constrain the marked cell.

query:marked_cell_candidate_count.answer_instruction: the number of legal candidate digits for the marked empty cell
query:marked_cell_candidate_count.annotation_hint: Set annotation to an object with key "marked_cell" containing one image-pixel cell bounding box [x0,y0,x1,y1], and key "constraint_cells" containing image-pixel bounding boxes for the visible filled cells that constrain the marked cell.

query:unit_missing_digits_count.answer_instruction: the number of different digit values missing from the highlighted unit
query:unit_missing_digits_count.annotation_hint: Set annotation to an array of image-pixel cell bounding boxes [x0,y0,x1,y1], one for each visible filled cell in the highlighted unit.

query:repeated_digit_count.answer_instruction: the number of different digit values that repeat in the highlighted unit
query:repeated_digit_count.annotation_hint: Set annotation to an array of image-pixel cell bounding boxes [x0,y0,x1,y1], one for each highlighted-unit cell whose digit value is repeated; use [] if no digit repeats.
